items.reason: Both "recurrent IDH wild-type GBM" and "recurrent IDH-mutated astrocytoma" are eligible, so IDH is not an entry requirement; it only defines the diagnoses. Not candidate-matched either way.

JCXH-211 "is a lipid nanoparticle (LNP) encapsulated srRNA, encoding the human IL-12 protein": a nucleic-acid product that makes the patient's cells express the cytokine, i.e. gene therapy, an excluded type; the IL-12 protein itself is not administered.
